decisions.finding: The vav shaft ends at y1016; after eight clear rows a detached broad horizontal stroke occupies y1024–1043. It has one continuous upper plateau, no pair of separate lower dots, and no long central descending qamats stem. Its literal same-letter patah comparator in lower-source ויהי3 is likewise a detached horizontal stroke [982,1271,1010,1281], area229 in zoom4, below shaft [974,1194,1003,1263]. The tiny lower-right residual is a three-row edge fragment, not a long central stem.

The short yod contour and the interior dot are separate connected components. The dot lies left of the lower yod shaft and below its broad cap; a clear white channel separates them. Same-row kaf in כי has a separate interior dot [412,970,431,981], area166.
